requirements.statement: Shoppers can browse a catalog of ceramics products

criteria.must: The catalog page lists available products
Each listed product shows at least its name and price

requirements.statement: Shoppers can view a single product's details including photos, description, price, and stock availability

criteria.must: The product detail page shows the product's photo
The product detail page shows the product's description
The product detail page shows the product's price
The product detail page shows current stock availability

requirements.statement: Shoppers can search or filter the catalog by category

criteria.must: Filtering by a category shows only products in that category
Searching by keyword returns matching products

requirements.statement: Shoppers can add products to a cart and adjust quantities

criteria.must: Adding a product to the cart increases the cart's item count
Changing a cart item's quantity updates the cart's subtotal

requirements.statement: Shoppers can remove items from their cart

criteria.must: Removing a cart item removes it from the cart contents
Removing a cart item updates the cart's total

requirements.statement: Shoppers can check out as a guest, providing shipping and payment details, without creating an account

criteria.must: A shopper with no account can complete checkout by providing shipping and payment details
A completed guest checkout creates an order

requirements.statement: Shoppers can sign in via SSO so their order history and details are saved

criteria.must: A shopper can sign in through the SSO flow
After signing in, the shopper's identity is retained for the session

requirements.statement: Signed-in shoppers can view their past orders and status

criteria.must: A signed-in shopper's order history page lists their previous orders
Each listed past order shows its current fulfillment status

requirements.statement: Shoppers receive an order confirmation after checkout

criteria.must: Completing checkout displays an order confirmation to the shopper
An order-confirmation email is sent after a successful checkout

requirements.statement: The store owner can sign in to an admin area accessible only to them

criteria.must: The store owner can sign in through the SSO flow to reach the admin area
A caller without store-owner sign-in cannot reach admin-only actions

requirements.statement: The store owner can add, edit, and remove products in the catalog

criteria.must: The store owner can add a new product that then appears in the catalog
The store owner can edit an existing product's details
The store owner can remove a product so it no longer appears in the catalog

requirements.statement: The store owner can set and update stock quantities for each product

criteria.must: The store owner can set a product's stock quantity
An updated stock quantity is reflected on the product's detail page

requirements.statement: The store prevents checkout of out-of-stock items

criteria.must: Attempting to add an out-of-stock product to the cart is rejected or blocked
Attempting to checkout with an item that is now out of stock is rejected

requirements.statement: The store owner can view incoming orders and update their fulfillment status

criteria.must: The store owner's order queue lists incoming orders
The store owner can change an order's fulfillment status (e.g. to shipped)
An updated fulfillment status is visible to the shopper on their order history
